title: The New Defcon Badges Pack a Unique Open Source Chip That Doubles as a Security Key
summary: The chip—called the Baochip-1x—is a “mostly” open source microcontroller that has been three years in the making and fulfills Huang’s years-long dream of making a chip whose security is verifiable.
